preconditions: Owned native POSIX test processes and temporary paths, an explicitly trusted Python executable/child program and explicit loader environment. Actual pipes, signals and waitpid ownership are exercised. Work compatibility metadata is an explicitly labelled recorded-build fixture.
steps: Run explicitly requested children synchronously with exact binary input/output and actual nonzero or signal status; observe completed child ownership through native waitpid.

Exercise literal arguments, explicit environment, closed implicit stdin and closed unrelated descriptors. Reject malformed contracts before launch and preserve actual native launch failure without retry.
Interrupt actual owned children through handled exception boundaries and a real isolated-parent SIGINT; check termination/reaping and preserved published Work bytes.

Run current read-only Work execution/finalization/export/restore and native preparation/publication with process and thread startup forbidden; confirm the actual completed results without background helpers.

oracle.requirement_contract: Der Core DARF NICHT für Fachoperationen Worker-Pools, Watcher, Hintergrundindexer oder einen dauerhaft laufenden Hilfsdienst starten.
oracle.scope: Current read-only and native Work paths execute without background threads, pools, watchers or helper-process startup. The explicit child adapter starts exactly one direct process per call, waits synchronously and retains no active process between calls. Initial explicitly trusted direct POSIX-child host API with whole-byte I/O. No invocation authority is derived from Work/project data. Future Git/analyzer adapters, large streaming protocols, child consumption accounting, repeated interruption/cleanup failures and non-POSIX operation remain open. No guarantee is claimed for daemonizing descendants or fatal unhandled host termination; no release approval or complete general command integration is claimed.
